Variants.Content: In November 218 BC, Hannibal's cavalry clashed with Roman reconnaissance forces under Consul Publius Cornelius Scipio along the Ticinus River. Hannibal's agile Numidian skirmish cavalry outflanked the Roman horsemen, delivering a stinging tactical defeat. The Consul was severely wounded and was saved only by the daring charge of his seventeen-year-old son, the future Scipio Africanus.
